cuts.head: over_shoulder
cuts.ofreeRecent: a quiet guesthouse breakfast nook beside an open courtyard — tasting warm rice pudding from a small spoon after an early swim; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a quiet campsite with a small tent and a cooking kit — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a neighborhood bakery window seat at early morning opening time — sharing the quiet ritual of breaking a warm roll for her own breakfast; the paved square before a city gate tower — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a Peking opera dressing room — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; an alchemist's potion workshop — standing close to a high shelf or line; her bedroom — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a dark jellyfish room — perched on a ledge or edge; a pilot ready room — holds a sleek pilot helmet with a tinted visor tucked under her arm against her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — crouching low on her heels; a night observatory under an open dome — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — standing
